crossRefs.note: After these things, the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker offended their lord, the king of Egypt.
But remember me when it is well with you. Please show kindness to me, and make mention of me to Pharaoh, and bring me…
Yet the chief cup bearer didn’t remember Joseph, but forgot him.

translations.web: Then the chief cup bearer spoke to Pharaoh, saying, “I remember my faults today.
translations.bsb: Then the chief cupbearer said to Pharaoh, “Today I recall my failures.
translations.kjv: Then spake the chief butler unto Pharaoh, saying, I do remember my faults this day:
